hints.title: Recursive Depth Product Aggregation
hints.text: Each integer value contributes to the global weighted sum scaled by its nesting level, beginning at one for the root list.

hints.title: Hierarchical Structure Traversal
hints.text: Iterate over elements in the current collection. If an element is a primitive integer, multiply its value by depth. If it is a nested container, recurse with depth incremented by one.

hints.title: DFS Subtree Accumulator Blueprint
hints.text: Define helper(item_list, depth). Initialize total = 0. For each item: if item.isInteger(), total += item.getInteger() * depth; else total += helper(item.getList(), depth + 1). Return total.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: total nested integers and sub-lists
complexity.notes: Visits every element and nested list once with call stack bounded by maximum depth.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Flattening without depth tracking loses parenthetical level context.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Call stack depth matches tree nesting level without auxiliary memory buffers.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handling arbitrary nesting levels and non-uniform list branches cleanly.
